_appid: Skip Steam: this is the 1998 PSX original. The only Steam listing is the 2017 'Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy' remake (appid 731490), a different product whose HD art and description would misrepresent what this package ships.
description: Crash Bandicoot 3: Warped (PSX 1998 USA, via RetroArch / SwanStation)

short: Crash chases Uka Uka through time to recover the Crystals, platforming across medieval castles, ancient Egypt, the Great Wall and prehistory -- with jetski, biplane and motorcycle stages between the run-and-jump levels.
